responsibility: Defines the second phase of Rust dead-code linting that scans crate items against the live-symbol set and emits warnings. Built on MarkLiveBase and the live HirIds produced by MarkLive::Analysis, it visits functions, structs, tuple structs, modules, and impl blocks to warn about never-used private functions, never-constructed structs, unread private struct fields, and unused associated functions in inherent impls, applying the lint policy rather than computing reachability.
